name: Lacosamide
aliases: ADD 234037, erlosamide, Erlosamide, harkeroside, Harkoseride, SPM 927, Vimpat®
summary: Lacosamide, sold under the brand name Vimpat among others, is a medication used for the treatment of focal-onset seizures and primary generalized tonic–clonic seizures. It is used by mouth or intravenously.
